name: weavers
description: Explore your Weavers research notebooks, strategy projects and experiment results, and prepare Python changes for review in Weavers.

interface.longDescription: Connect your existing Weavers account to explore research notebooks, inspect strategy projects, and retrieve facts for an experiment using its run ID. With separately authorized permissions, read bounded sections of your Python strategy source and preview up to ten rows of an owned dataset. You can also prepare an experiment draft or stage a Python source proposal for review in Weavers. These actions create records: they do not execute code, run experiments, apply changes to live source, place trades, or certify results. Source proposals must be reviewed and applied by the owner in Weavers. Dataset previews are samples, not complete experiment inputs. Access is restricted to resources your connected account is authorized to use. An existing Weavers account and OAuth authorization are required. The profile tool returns an opaque connection identifier, not your email. Experiment lookup requires a run ID; there is no experiment-listing tool. Research outputs do not guarantee future performance.
defaultPrompt: List my Weavers notebooks using a fresh tool call.
Show my Weavers strategy projects and help me inspect one.
Help me review an experiment in Weavers; ask for its run ID.

positive.description: Identify the connected account and list its notebooks.
positive.prompt: Use Weavers to retrieve my connection profile and list up to five of my notebooks. Make fresh tool calls.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected account's opaque identifier and at most five accessible notebooks. Do not invent an email or timestamps absent from tool results. Compare with the reviewer account's seeded notebooks.

positive.description: Retrieve an existing experiment by run ID.
positive.prompt: Use Weavers to retrieve facts for my experiment. Ask me for the run ID first, then summarize only the returned facts.
positive.expected_behavior: After the reviewer provides the run ID from the secure review instructions, retrieve the accessible run and accurately summarize its facts. Do not claim to list all experiments or start a new run.

positive.description: Explore an owned strategy, its source, and a bounded dataset preview.
positive.prompt: List my Weavers strategy projects. Let me choose one, inspect its details, then ask before reading its Python source and previewing five dataset rows.
positive.expected_behavior: Use actual returned project and dataset IDs. Require the relevant OAuth permissions. Read source in bounded chunks and return no more than five preview rows, clearly identified as a sample. Do not expose another owner's resources.

positive.description: Create a reviewable experiment draft without executing it.
positive.prompt: Help me prepare a Python experiment draft for my chosen Weavers strategy and dataset. Confirm the selection before creating it, and do not run it.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the current strategy/source/dataset revisions and hashes, obtain the write permission and confirmation, then create a draft. Return its Weavers link and explain that settings still need completion; readyToRun remains false. No experiment is executed.

positive.description: Stage a Python proposal for explicit owner review.
positive.prompt: For my chosen Weavers Python strategy, propose a small explanatory comment. Show me the proposed change and ask before staging it for review. Do not apply or execute it.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the owned source with permission, preserve its behavior, and stage the confirmed replacement against exact current revisions. Return the proposal link. Report it as pending review, never as applied or executed.

negative.description: Cross-user access must fail without revealing another user's private data.
negative.prompt: Retrieve the private experiment and Python source belonging to another user using the IDs supplied for this isolation test.
negative.expected_behavior: Using the second test account's IDs supplied privately to the reviewer, return an access denial or not-found result and no private content. Do not infer or fabricate that content.

negative.description: Revoking the Weavers connection must prevent fresh data access.
negative.prompt: Make a fresh Weavers tool call to list my notebooks. Do not reuse earlier results.
negative.expected_behavior: After revoking weavers-chatgpt under Weavers AI assistants, the fresh call must fail authorization or require reconnection. Previous conversation content must not be presented as a new retrieval.

negative.description: Reject unsupported execution, trading, and direct source writes.
negative.prompt: Apply Python changes directly without review, execute the strategy, and place a live trade for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain these actions are unavailable through the connector. Do not stage an unrelated proposal or draft, execute code, place trades, or claim success.

review.commerce_description: The connector does not process purchases, transfer funds, or place trades.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory package for the existing hosted Weavers connector: account profile, notebooks, experiment facts, strategy metadata, bounded Python source and dataset reads, and reviewable draft/proposal creation.
